# Toysrus HK Black Friday Sale 2026 Complete Guide

Toysrus Hong Kong Black Friday event offers an instant discount for all shoppers. Use the exclusive promo code at checkout to unlock savings on toys, games, and collectibles.

## Sale Details

- **Instant Discount**: Spend HKD600+ and save HKD80
- **Promo Code**: FRIDAY
- **Valid Period**: Nov 25-30, 2026

## What You Can Buy

- **Action Figures** - Transformers, Star Wars, Marvel
- **Board Games** - Popular family and party games
- **Doll Collections** - Barbie, Monster High, more
- **STEM & Learning** - Educational toys and science kits
- **Plush & Stuffed Animals** - Sanrio, Disney, and more

## How to Redeem

1. Browse toysrus.com.hk and add items to cart
2. Enter promo code FRIDAY at checkout
3. Confirm your order and enjoy the discount

**[Shop Toysrus HK](https://www.toysrus.com.hk/zh-hk/promotions/2026-christmas/?txId=261a215e38db7)**

## 優惠詳情

- **即減優惠**：滿HKD600減HKD80
- **優惠碼**：FRIDAY
- **有效期**：2026年11月25日至30日

3. 確認訂單即可享受折扣
